## Read in the stratum results

```{r}
adult_strata <- read_result("res_adult_strata")
youth_strata <- read_result("res_youth_strata")
adult_curves <- read_result("res_adult_curves")
youth_curves <- read_result("res_youth_curves")
```

## Figure 2: the three assumptions across the life course

Every estimate is sex-adjusted. Youth strata are single years (2–20 for β; 8–20 for the
DXA panels) and adult strata are decades. Points sit at the median age of each stratum.

```{r}
### stack youth and adult estimates for one panel
life_course <- function(youth, adult, youth_stratum, value, panel) {
  bind_rows(
    youth |> transmute(cohort = lbl_cohort[["youth"]],  stratum = as.character(.data[[youth_stratum]]),
                       n, age_mid, est = .data[[value]], lo, hi),
    adult |> transmute(cohort = lbl_cohort[["adults"]], stratum = as.character(age_decade),
                       n, age_mid, est = .data[[value]], lo, hi)
  ) |>
    mutate(panel = panel, .before = 1)
}

fig2 <- bind_rows(
  ### Figure 2A: allometric exponent β by age
  life_course(youth_strata$beta,  adult_strata$beta,  "age",     "beta", "A"),
  ### Figure 2B: partial correlation of height with %BF
  life_course(youth_strata$hf,    adult_strata$hf,    "age",     "r",    "B"),
  ### Figure 2C: %BF at BMI 25 (sex-adjusted GAM)
  life_course(youth_strata$pbf25, adult_strata$pbf25, "age_grp", "pbf",  "C")
)

adult_mean_pbf25 <- fig2 |> filter(panel == "C", cohort == lbl_cohort[["adults"]]) |> pull(est) |> mean()
cli::cli_alert_info("Mean %BF at BMI 25 across adult strata (Fig 2C dashed line): {round(adult_mean_pbf25, 1)}")

fig2 |> filter(cohort == lbl_cohort[["adults"]]) |> knitr::kable(digits = 3)
save_result(list(estimates = fig2, adult_mean_pbf25 = adult_mean_pbf25), "res_fig2")
```

## Figure 8C: drift in %BF at fixed BMI, youth vs adults

At each reference BMI (20–35), %BF from the sex-specific stratum curves (Figure 8A–B) is
regressed on stratum age (unweighted OLS). The x position is the decade midpoint for adults
(`midpts()`: "70+" = 75, see DISCREPANCIES Q6) and the single year of age for youth. The
slope is the drift in percentage points per year.

```{r}
sweep <- bind_rows(
  adult_curves$sweep |> transmute(cohort = lbl_cohort[["adults"]],    sex, stratum = as.character(age_decade), ref_bmi, pbf),
  youth_curves$sweep |> transmute(cohort = lbl_cohort[["youth_dxa"]], sex, stratum = as.character(age_grp),    ref_bmi, pbf)
) |>
  mutate(age_x = midpts(stratum))

drift <- drift_sweep(sweep)
drift |> filter(ref_bmi == 25) |> knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

### Average drift over reference BMIs where every stratum contributes

```{r}
drift_mean <- drift |>
  filter(full_support) |>
  group_by(cohort, sex) |>
  summarise(n_ref = n(), mean_pp_per_year = mean(pp_per_year),
            min = min(pp_per_year), max = max(pp_per_year), .groups = "drop")
drift_mean |> knitr::kable(digits = 3)

dm <- function(c, s) drift_mean |> filter(cohort == lbl_cohort[[c]], sex == s) |> pull(mean_pp_per_year)
record_stat("drift_youth_m", dm("youth_dxa", "Males"))
record_stat("drift_adult_m", dm("adults",    "Males"))
record_stat("drift_fold_m",  abs(dm("youth_dxa", "Males")   / dm("adults", "Males")))
record_stat("drift_youth_f", dm("youth_dxa", "Females"))
record_stat("drift_adult_f", dm("adults",    "Females"))
record_stat("drift_fold_f",  abs(dm("youth_dxa", "Females") / dm("adults", "Females")))
adult_full <- drift |> filter(cohort == lbl_cohort[["adults"]], full_support) |> pull(pp_per_year)
record_stat("adult_drift_range_min", min(adult_full), "lowest adult drift over reference BMIs 20–35, both sexes")
record_stat("adult_drift_range_max", max(adult_full), "highest adult drift over reference BMIs 20–35, both sexes")
record_stat("box_adult_drift",    mean(c(dm("adults", "Females"), dm("adults", "Males"))), "mean of the sex means")
record_stat("impact_adult_drift", mean(c(dm("adults", "Females"), dm("adults", "Males"))), "mean of the sex means")
record_stat("impact_youth_drift_max",
            max(abs(drift$pp_per_year[drift$cohort == lbl_cohort[["youth_dxa"]] & drift$sex == "Males"])),
            "largest |drift| in boys over reference BMIs 20–35")

save_result(list(drift = drift, drift_mean = drift_mean, sweep = sweep), "res_fig8c")
```

## Figure 9: Hattori chart

Mean fat-free mass index (FFMI) and fat mass index (FMI) for each sex × age stratum: youth
in single years (8–20) and adults in 5-year bands (21–24 … 80+). Only participants with DXA.

```{r}
adults_dxa <- read_result("adults") |> filter(has_dxa)
kids_dxa   <- read_result("kids_dxa")

hattori <- bind_rows(
  kids_dxa   |> mutate(cohort = lbl_cohort[["youth_dxa"]], stratum = as.character(age)),
  adults_dxa |> mutate(cohort = lbl_cohort[["adults"]],    stratum = as.character(age_5y))
) |>
  group_by(cohort, sex, stratum) |>
  summarise(n = n(), age_mid = median(age), ffmi = mean(ffmi), fmi = mean(fmi),
            bmi = mean(bmi), pbf = mean(pbf), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(sex, age_mid)

hattori |> count(cohort, sex, wt = n, name = "participants") |> knitr::kable()
save_result(hattori, "res_fig9")
```
